<p class="skill-reference-meta"><span>Arcantry 1.0.0</span><code>select-task-skills</code></p>

Choose at most three available skills whose non-overlapping workflows materially improve a complex task.

## When to use

Choose at most three available skills whose distinct workflows materially help a complex, multi-domain, or unfamiliar task. Do not use for simple work or install anything.

## Link this skill

```text
arcantry skills link select-task-skills --scope user
```

The standard destination is `~/.agents/skills`. Codex reads this universal Agent Skills location directly.

### Claude compatibility

```text
arcantry skills link select-task-skills --scope user --compat claude
```

This keeps the universal link and adds a Claude alias to the same canonical package.

## Examples

### Route a multi-domain task

**Prompt**

> Use the select-task-skills skill for this repository task and choose no more than three skills that materially improve it.

**Expected outcome**

A short use-now or install-first selection based on actual triggers, with overlapping candidates omitted.

### Discover project-local skills

**Prompt**

> Use the select-task-skills skill to check whether this project declares a skill for the unfamiliar workflow I requested.

**Expected outcome**

A catalog-backed recommendation that does not install, enable, update, or remove any skill.
